name: Barbell Overhead Press
description: Press the bar from the front of your shoulders to straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let it pass.

source.title: Standing Shoulder Press (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with the bar resting across the front of your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder-width.
cues: Squeeze your glutes so your back doesn't arch.
Press straight up, then bring your head through.
Lower to your shoulders with control.

prescription.note: Warm up with lighter sets first. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Bar at your shoulders
keyframes.cue: Elbows slightly in front of the bar.
